# Core: Notification Template (Resource)

Manage Synology DSM notification templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "synology_core_notification_template" "custom" {
  name = "Terraform Managed Template"

  settings = {
    docker_container_unexpected_exit = false
    route_down                       = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification template name.
- `settings` (Map of Boolean) Template settings map where keys are notification tags and values enable or disable each tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification template ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a Synology default template.
